text: きみを　みくびって　いた　ようだ　ぼくに　かった　あかしに　ポケモン　リーグ　こうにん　グレー　バッジを　さずけよう！

structure.jp: きみを　みくびって　いた　ようだ
structure.en: it seems I was underestimating you

structure.jp: ぼくに　かった　あかしに
structure.en: as proof that you beat me

structure.jp: ポケモン　リーグ　こうにん　グレー　バッジを　さずけよう！
structure.en: I'll confer the official Pokémon League Boulder Badge!

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.span: みくびって　いた　ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ at the end says 'it seems that', a judgment from what the speaker has seen. みくびって　いた　ようだ = 'it seems I was underestimating you'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ぼくに　かった　あかし
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. ぼくに　かった　あかし = 'proof that you beat me'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb ending to よう says 'I will' or 'let's', a decision made on the spot. さずけよう = 'I shall confer it'.
